rules: All rank arrivals and necessary arithmetic/rounding use the fixed original data and shard layout. The QLI term prices only the four candidate-consuming token accumulators. It preserves score production, ordered output, the block list and index preparation. Credit is a sensitivity of the original kernel time; token sorting time was not separately exported.

Sparse KV net transfer and first-PV FP32 identity read/write are disjoint costs inside one SMLA task; both are billed together against one remaining SWA+compressed QK/PV floor. Fold and gather together are not added to a prior total that already includes gather.

All eager terms enter their first affected TP8 exchange then EP16. Graph: join four actual QLI/prepare/SMLA/pack identities, TP8 AllToAll identity, F21 row and EP16 clock constraints to the same worker replay. QLI + SMLA on these layers pass both frontiers once. Geometry estimates for remaining graph layers, HC and frozen OA fallback follow the archived cost model. Partial DP slots pay 0..physical capacity for KV/partial gains; unchanged measured QLI still executes.

Clock extrema at different joins need not be simultaneously attained. Aligned marginals subtract counterfactuals under one fixed clock convention. Outer marginal intervals subtract opposite endpoints; the interval is conservative. Every case stops at each of the eight actual deadlines. Local critical time is assumed to pass through later host and device work at full exposure.

Corrected sensitivity transfers separate 171 per-layer DP medians only to natural four-by-six-token graph waves; it preserves stock durations for eager and other graph shapes. This is an incremental sort budget using an old schedule and denominator, not a combined service measurement.

Ordinary scenarios retain own prompt and two separate original request durations and step counts. High side credits a possible single peer prefill, and for optional QLI uses a deliberately generous five-call-plus-preparation fixture as a proxy for four consumers. Low side grants no optional QLI contribution. Different caches, valid lengths, added synchronization, physical rates and transfer to the client remain unmeasured.
